thread:
maya: noticed alerts not paging to oncall for last ~10m. watch? :rotating_light:
chen: seeing same. incidentbot didn't create a page for 3 failed webhooks.
ops-bot: automated-suppressor reported a join_race on channel join event — mapping not established.
chen: grabbing logs now, looks like concurrent join events from connector and automation. paste: 
```json
{"ts":1765433300,"event":"channel_join","id":"evt_abc","user":"incidentbot"}
{"ts":1765433301,"event":"channel_join","id":"evt_def","user":"automation"}
{"ts":1765433302,"error":"duplicate_member_conflict","detail":"join race prevented mapping"}
```
pranav: I'm oncall. I didn't get paged. manual page to me? @lina please call the customer.
lina: calling now, on hold. any immediate mitigation?
maya: for now, manual escalate to oncall + disable auto-join in connector until fix.
chen: root cause hypothesis: connector re-sync emits simultaneous join events; incidentbot's join handler is not idempotent and routing mapping isn't atomically written -> page suppressed by routing filter.
pranav: ok, can you hotfix to debounce join events or fallback to user-id based mapping? timeline?
chen: pushing quick debounce patch to canary now. will revert re-sync if needed. patch flag: `join_debounce_ms=2000`.
incidentbot: patch deployed to canary, reprocessing 8 pending events.
ops-bot: runbook reminder -> docs/runbooks/paging-integration.md explains manual fallback: use `/incident manual-page <sev> <desc>` or call oncall if automation fails.
maya: customer impact: one high-sev alert didn't reach oncall for ~9m; customer experienced degraded s3 ingestion across several tenants. Lina on call with them.
lina: on call, customer confirms degraded ingests from 13:04–13:13 UTC; we enabled temporary scaling and opened a support ticket; they requested ETA and RCA.
pranav: thanks. next steps: (1) keep debounce in canary for 30m and monitor, (2) revert workspace re-sync and run single-threaded join, (3) prepare postmortem if scope > single customer.
maya: I'll own the postmortem draft. chen pls include logs, timeline, and PR link.
chen: will do. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1428, logs collected at s3://redwood-ops/incident-1765433333/
pranav: closing ops loop for now. ping when canary shows no misses. :thumbsup:
